## Orcish Warclops (CR 6)

**XP** 2,400  
 N Large construct  
 Init—2; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +0  

**Defense**

 **AC** 19, touch 7, flat-footed 19 (+4 armor, –2 Dex, +8 natural, –1 size)  
 **hp** 74 (8d10+30)  
 **Fort** +2, **Ref** +0, **Will** +2  
 **DR** 5/adamantine; **Immune** construct traits, magic  
 **Weakness** poorly made  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 40 ft.  
 **Melee** 3 slam +11 (2d6+4)  
 **Space** 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.  
 **Special Attacks** destructive frenzy  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 18, **Dex** 7, Con—, Int—, **Wis** 11, **Cha** 1  
 **Base Atk** +8; **CMB** +13; **CMD** 21 (23 vs. trip)  
 **Languages** none  

**Special Abilities**

 **Destructive Frenzy (Ex)** If a orcish warclops takes damage, on its next turn it can take a free move action before making a full attack action. Doing so, however, causes the construct to take 2d6 points of damage. This damage bypasses the orcish warclops’ damage reduction.  

 **Immunity to Magic (Ex)** An orcish warclops is immune to any spell or spell-like ability that allows spell resistance. In addition, certain spells and effects function differently agains the creature as noted below.
